program_name: T-CAIREM Continuous SetOperator AF-Density Research Program

models.name: EchoNext Continuous D1 SetOperator
models.description: Canonical continuous SetOperator with 8->64->64 MLP operator encoder, ModulatedPhaseCNN, 2-layer Transformer d_model=192, attention pooling, Linear(256, 1) AF head. Reconstruction decoder excluded from diagnostic forward path.
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + continuous lead coordinates q in R^8
models.primary_hypothesis: Continuous lead projection vectors break set-token symmetry, eliminating activation collapse and enabling multi-lead invariance.

models.name: Matched Categorical SetOperator Control
models.description: Discrete categorical operator baseline mapping channel index ID in {0, 1} to an embedding vector. Matched exactly in parameter count to A001.
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + categorical lead index in {0, 1}
models.primary_hypothesis: Categorical IDs lack metric grounding, causing Transformer active tokens to collapse to near-constant output (SD < 1e-6, prob ~0.2284).

models.name: Channel-Agnostic Operator-Ablated Control
models.description: SetOperator with operator conditioning completely zeroed out (q = 0). Evaluates performance of an unguided set transformer.
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) with zeroed operator coordinates
models.primary_hypothesis: Without operator guidance, the model cannot distinguish Lead I from Lead II, reducing AUROC to near-chance under channel swaps.

models.name: 2D Continuous Projection SetOperator
models.description: Continuous SetOperator where lead geometry is restricted strictly to the 2D frontal Einthoven plane (q in R^2).
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + 2D frontal lead coordinates
models.primary_hypothesis: 2D planar projection provides sufficient rotation invariance in frontal plane, but cannot represent precordial leads V1-V6.

models.name: Dual-Moment Distributional Morphology Pooling
models.description: Computes both empirical mean and empirical variance across Phase-KME response atoms prior to set encoding, capturing fibrillatory wave variance.
models.inputs: Dual-moment Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 256) + q in R^8
models.primary_hypothesis: Preserving beat morphology variance improves paroxysmal AF detection and reduces continuous density MAE to <= 0.26.

models.name: Ordered-Beat Dynamics (BiGRU Token Sequence)
models.description: Augments beat tokens with normalized inter-beat interval Delta t_k and relative timing, followed by a bidirectional recurrent GRU encoder.
models.inputs: Ordered beat sequence with RR delta timings + Phase-KME atoms + q in R^8
models.primary_hypothesis: Explicit beat order injects rhythm irregularity transitions into the set representation, reducing false PAC/PVC alarms.

models.name: Transformer-Free Masked Mean Pooling Baseline
models.description: Replaces the 2-layer Transformer set encoder with simple masked mean pooling across active channels, followed by a linear classification head.
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + q in R^8 (masked mean pooling)
models.primary_hypothesis: Serves as an ultra-compact deletion baseline to quantify the exact value added by the self-attention set encoder.

models.name: Multimodal RR Dynamics Hybrid
models.description: Combines the continuous SetOperator morphology latent with an explicit 36-feature statistical RR branch (mean, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, SampEn).
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + 36-D RR interval features
models.primary_hypothesis: Explicit statistical rhythm features provide superior burden accuracy (Burden MAE <= 0.10) and best probability calibration (ECE <= 0.16).

models.name: Authentic Raw 1D ResNet Baseline
models.description: Standard 8-block 1D deep residual network operating directly on authentic 6000-sample raw ECG waveforms at 200 Hz with channel masking.
models.inputs: Authentic Raw ECG voltage (B, 2, 6000) + lead coordinates q in R^8
models.primary_hypothesis: Fixed-channel 1D ResNet provides high temporal boundary resolution but fails under lead dropout, permutation, and spatial rotation.

models.name: Residual MLP Capacity Control
models.description: Continuous SetOperator with an auxiliary residual 2-layer MLP bypass. Preserved as a capacity-matched control for I082-v2.
models.inputs: Phase-KME feature maps (B, 2, 16, 128) + MLP residual branch
models.primary_hypothesis: Ensures that performance gains in residual fusion are not merely due to increased parameter capacity.

models.name: Authentic ResNet-Residual Fusion Architecture
models.description: Genuine ResNet + SetOperator Residual Fusion (I082-v2): Combines authentic 1D raw ECG ResNet branch (2,186,049 params) with continuous Phase-KME SetOperator branch (1,027,009 params) via a learnable zero-initialized residual scalar parameter alpha (logit_fused = logit_raw + alpha * delta_logit). Total exact parameters: 3,213,059.
models.inputs: Raw ECG voltage (B, 2, 6000) + Phase-KME features (B, 2, 16, 128) + q in R^8
models.primary_hypothesis: Fusing raw voltage high-frequency edges with continuous SetOperator latents resolves boundary jitter (< 8s) while retaining lead invariance.

models.name: Mean + Variance Distributional Phase-KME
models.description: Concatenates cell mean and variance across cardiac cycle beats.

models.name: Tri-Moment (Mean + Var + Skewness) Phase-KME
models.description: Adds 3rd central moment (skewness) to capture beat waveform asymmetry.

models.name: Quad-Moment (Mean + Var + Skew + Kurtosis)
models.description: Adds 4th central moment (kurtosis) to detect rare morphologic outliers.

models.name: Quantile-Based (10th, 50th, 90th percentile) Phase-KME
models.description: Nonparametric quantile pooling robust to single-beat motion artifacts.

models.name: Energy-Weighted Moment Phase-KME
models.description: Weights beat contribution by local high-frequency power before pooling.

models.name: Inter-Quartile Range (IQR) Dispersion Phase-KME
models.description: Captures beat-to-beat morphology spread without outlier distortion.
